remarks: Completely Remodeled spacious with lots of natural light second floor Condo unit located at Kingsley Court. This unit offers hardwood floors, Remodeled kitchen with updated appliances and bathroom. Crown molding, freshly painted, large spacious bed room with tow generous sized closets. water heater, snow removal, Landscaping, Common area maintenance, 1 parking space, Community room in the center of the complex ail included in rent. Garage which includes storage cabinets & refrigerator for an Additional cost of $250 per month. Located conveniently with access to I-95 and Merritt Parkway. Very close to Norwalk hospital, Sono Mall Collections, Maritime Aquarium, and many local restaurants and shops. All applicants are required to do a Rentspree Application.
